script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The passage does not say sending messengers was Ahaziah's first move after his fall.
Saying Ahaziah was never planning to go to Elijah claims knowledge of his plans beyond what the text says.
The text does not say Ahaziah asked for good news. The messengers met Elijah, but the king did not receive the message on the road.
The text does not describe whether the king blinked or otherwise reacted before identifying Elijah.
The text does not say how quickly the king answered.
The captain tells Elijah to come down, but the text does not say the king ordered Elijah brought to him.
The text does not say the king wanted Elijah close to him. The captain delivers an order to come down.
The second order adds urgency, but the text does not say it was louder.
The passage does not say that Elijah's request for fire was spoken for God rather than on his own.
The line about nobody getting a head start makes light of the captains and men's deaths.
The text does not say whether a messenger from the king reached the captain and his men.
The joke about doing the math and trying something different treats the deaths of the first two companies too lightly.
The captain knows what happened to the first two companies, but the text does not say he has just heard about it.
The text attributes the instruction to the angel of the LORD; it does not say the LORD gave that instruction to the angel.
